pull.title: KAFKA-19414: Revert 2PC public API changes for 4.4
pull.body:
We are removing some of the previously added public APIs until KIP-939 is ready to use. Similar to the [4.3 PR](https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/21902).

This is a cherry-pick of the 4.3 revert (`c41ff4de0e`) onto 4.4. Five of the six files applied cleanly; the conflicts below were resolved manually:

### `clients/.../producer/KafkaProducer.java`
1. **Import block** — 4.4 relocated `AppInfoParser`, `LogContext`, and `ProducerIdAndEpoch` to `org.apache.kafka.common.utils.internals.*`. Kept 4.4's import layout and dropped the now-unused `internals.ProducerIdAndEpoch` import (the revert removed its only usages).
2. **`prepareTransaction()` region** — this overlapped with a new 4.4 method, `awaitTopicMetadata()`. Kept `awaitTopicMetadata()` and removed only the reverted `prepareTransaction()` method and its javadoc.

### `clients/.../producer/KafkaProducerTest.java`
The revert only removed the old `org.apache.kafka.common.utils.ProducerIdAndEpoch` import path; in 4.4 that import had moved to `...utils.internals.ProducerIdAndEpoch`, so it was left behind and is now unused after the revert. Removed it to keep checkstyle happy.

The internal `TransactionManager` 2PC plumbing is untouched, matching the scope of the 4.3 PR.

Reviewers: Justine Olshan <jolshan@confluent.io>
